metadata.description: LinkedIn Strategy Kit — a strategy builder + a profile audit, the two-skill foundation of a LinkedIn content system. Set the strategy config, then align the profile to it.

plugins.name: linkedin-strategy-kit
plugins.description: Two skills: /strategy builds a 9-section machine-readable LinkedIn strategy in Notion (ICP, voice profile, pillars, offer audit, viral levers, distribution); /profile-audit audits the profile against the 2026 framework + that strategy into concrete rewrites, a banner brief, and a Featured plan.
